name: expectations
title: Expected grades per record, version, profile and direction (long)
description: The DEFAULT profile repeats the EXP_* columns of records.csv. Alternative profiles are published only for the records they change; a record absent under a profile keeps its DEFAULT expectation.

fields.name: DIRECTION
fields.description: LOW and HIGH scales, or WORST = single worst grade across directions

fields.name: TERM
fields.description: Expected CTCAE term; blank when no term applies

fields.name: BASE_GRADE
fields.description: Expected grade of the subject's baseline record in this direction; blank when there is no baseline or the record is NOT DONE
